proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the lens model/engraving (front ring and side) and both lens elements (front and rear).
A short video test: power on, autofocus on a subject, take a photo, and playback on the screen.
A photo of the camera’s rear screen/menu showing key settings and (if possible) shutter count/firmware info.
A photo of the battery label and a clip showing the battery powering the camera for a short shooting session.
A full inventory photo of everything included (charger type, cables, caps, strap, memory card if any).
response.reason: The photos confirm the Nikon Z fc body (photo 0), but the exact lens identity and the camera’s functional condition/shutter count are not provable from the images provided, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the missing decisive proof.
